scenarios.name: Choose an additional command while another modeling command is active

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible with Modify unpinned
the Shell command is active with its properties and preview visible
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the user selects Move Bodies from that area
the Shell properties and preview close
the Move Bodies dialog and its preview are visible
the original solid remains visible without a new Shell or Move Bodies feature
